parameters.query: SELECT m.id::text AS mailbox_id FROM alice.imap_mailboxes m WHERE m.owner_id = $1::uuid UNION SELECT a.mailbox_id::text FROM alice.imap_mailbox_access a WHERE a.user_id = $1::uuid

SELECT m.imap_host, m.imap_port, m.imap_username, m.password_enc, m.ssl_enabled FROM alice.imap_mailboxes m WHERE m.id = $1::uuid AND (m.owner_id = $2::uuid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alice.imap_mailbox_access a WHERE a.mailbox_id = m.id AND a.user_id = $2::uuid))

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ host: $json.host, port: $json.port, username: $json.username, password: $json.password, ssl: $json.ssl, uid: $json.uid }) }}
